summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the submission of its 2026 Interim Report (half-year ended 30 June 2026) to the UK National Storage Mechanism and its availability on the company website. Printed copies will be mailed to shareholders on 21 August 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of interim financial results by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situations event. No transaction, strategic action, or unusual corporate development is described. The announcement solely complies with UK disclosure obligations (DTR 6.3.5R(1A)) and contains no deal terms, recommendations, or event-driven elements.
